text:
incidents-bot: 🔔 PagerDuty: synth-check-eu-west-1 (probe_id=pc-9421) fired at 2026-11-03T02:45:21Z - 5/5 failures over 2m. Threshold: 4 failures.
pagerduty: INCIDENT #82314 assigned to alex (ack required). Link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/82314
alex: ack'd. investigating — checking probe logs and recent deploys. @maria @samir fyi.
maria: seeing same on dashboards, spike in 5xx for synths hitting /v1/health-check route, avg latency +250ms in eu-west.
samir: pulling canary-runner logs now. quick grep: ``grep pc-9421 /var/log/synth-runner.log | tail -n 50`` shows timeout to upstream inference-gateway at ~1000ms.
alex: any recent traffic shaping or routing changes to eu-west? I don't see deploys in last 6h. checking routing policies.
jess: infra-alert: BGP flaps reported in eu-west peering earlier but marked resolved at 01:30Z. Could be related to transient connections.
incidents-bot: auto-escalation: 82314 -> pagerduty escalation policy "synth-prod" at +5m.
maria: starting quick smoke: ``curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' https://eu-west.api.redwood.ai/v1/health-check`` returning 504 / 1.12s from my laptop (iam in eu).
samir: probed the gateway from control-plane: ``tcpdump`` shows SYN retransmits to backend nodes; some TCP RTT spikes. Opening node-level metrics.
alex: workplan: 1) confirm customer impact (which routes), 2) narrow to infra vs model runtime, 3) apply mitigation (route fallback to ded-pool or restart bad gateway pods).
jess: ops: scaling alerts show dedicated-gateway-eu had CPU backpressure on 3/8 pods and 2 pods OOM-killed in last 10m. Could be a ripple.
alex: switching synth route to fallback variant (non-weighted) for eu-west to avoid using gateway-eu cluster. Doing incremental traffic shift. ``/api/routes/shift --route synth-eu --target=eu-fallback --percent=100``
maria: after shift: synths green from my terminal, 200s with <100ms. Confirming with the incident dashboard.
pagerduty: alex acknowledged at 2026-11-03T02:48:10Z. Assignment updated.
samir: running rolling restart on gateway-eu pods to clear suspected memory leak: ``kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway-eu -n prod`` — doing 1 pod at a time.
jess: note — customer-facing model endpoints still ok due to smart routing to other regions, observed only synth checks failing. Indirect customer risk low but should monitor.
alex: capturing timeline and runbook steps into incident doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/82314 (draft).
maria: alert noise reduced; canaries stable for 6m post-fallback. Marking mitigation successful for now.
incidents-bot: auto-note: mitigation applied: route-fallback -> eu-fallback, rolling-restart gateway-eu.
alex: handing off to oncall-next for post-incident verification and RCA prep. @oncall-next can you take it from here?
oncall-next: taking handoff. I'll keep the channel open, will collect pod logs and heap dumps for the OOMs, and schedule a short RCA sync. ETA 30m.
pagerduty: incident resolved? closing condition: canaries stable for 15m and no customer errors. Current: stable 8m.
samir: grabbing logs and will upload traces to the incident doc. ``/usr/local/bin/collect-traces --since 2026-11-03T02:30:00Z --probe pc-9421``
jess: FYI I'll create a follow-up alert rule to detect the gateway OOM pattern earlier.
alex: thanks all. adding postmortem owners: samir (data), jess (network/infra), maria (synths). We'll aim for RCA draft in 48h. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty: incident #82314 marked "acknowledged" and then "resolved" by alex at 2026-11-03T03:06:40Z (notes: fallback applied, rolling restart).
